description: An expander for Quad Algorithmic Rhythm, placed immediately to its right, that moves steps earlier or later than the beat they fall on.

params.text: Applies this groove to that track of the Quad Algorithmic Rhythm; unlit, the track is left alone.
Makes the groove pattern run the same length as the track it is applied to, in place of the length setting.
Sets how many steps the groove pattern runs for, 1 to 18, repeating whatever the length of the track it is applied to.
Scales the voltage at the groove length input, -100% to +100%.
Interpolates between straight time and the full swing pattern, 0% to 100%.
Scales the voltage at the groove amount input, -100% to +100%.
Sets how far each beat is moved at random, 0% to 100%; at 100% a beat can land half a beat either side of its time.
Scales the voltage at the groove randomness input, -100% to +100%.
Switches the random movement from an even spread to a gaussian one, where most beats land close to their own time.
Shifts that step of the groove pattern earlier or later, -50% to +50% of a beat.
Scales the voltage at that step's swing input, -100% to +100%, before it is added to the step's own setting.
Switches the pattern from following steps to following beats, so its entries land on the 1st beat, 2nd beat and so on whichever steps those fall on.

inputs.text: Voltage adds to the groove pattern length, 1.8 steps per volt at full attenuverter.
Voltage moves the groove between straight time and the full pattern, 10V for the whole way at full attenuverter.
Voltage sets the amount of random movement, 10V for the full amount at full attenuverter.
Voltage shifts that step earlier or later through its own attenuverter; 10V at full attenuverter is a 50% shift.

notes: A QAR Grid Control expander placed immediately to the right of this module replaces the 18 swing settings with the shape drawn in its grid.
